pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Cart Item Pricing Before Asserting Totals
lesson.when: A customer updates cart items or states a total budget and requests cart verification, but product prices or total amounts have not been retrieved or verified via tools.
lesson.do: Retrieve product pricing using system tools and verify cart item costs before stating or confirming total amounts.
lesson.otherwise: Express uncertainty about the total cart cost without stating unconfirmed prices or totals.
